name: x-session-reader
description: Read posts and bookmarks visible to a user-provided X/Twitter web session cookie, without bypassing login or anti-bot checks.

X_COOKIES.prompt: Paste your X/Twitter cookies as a JSON array exported from your browser, or as a raw Cookie header.

CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH.prompt: Optional Chrome/Chromium executable path. Defaults to Playwright's cached Chromium.

HEADLESS.prompt: Run browser headless: true or false.
